title: Services · GitLab
description: Provisioned service health dashboard. Current checks are freshness-gated; missing data is unknown. See panel descriptions for scope and limits.

options.content: Compare direct access, public routes and GitLab components. Grey means missing or stale evidence. Firing rules may be inhibited by a parent incident.

panels.title: Public access
panels.description: Current external route probe: DNS, TLS, ingress and the configured application path. Results older than 90 seconds or failed exporter scrapes are unknown.

targets.expr: probe_success{job="blackbox",service=~"gitlab|registry|gitlab-runner",layer="edge"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="blackbox"} == 1) and on (job, instance) (time() - timestamp(probe_success{job="blackbox"}) < 90)

panels.title: Direct services
panels.description: Current direct backend probe. Compare with the edge panel to distinguish ingress failures from backend failures; this is not a full user transaction.

targets.expr: probe_success{job="blackbox",service=~"gitlab|registry|gitlab-runner",layer="core"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="blackbox"} == 1) and on (job, instance) (time() - timestamp(probe_success{job="blackbox"}) < 90)

panels.title: Probe duration
panels.description: End-to-end duration of each configured probe, including failed attempts. Historical data; gaps are not bridged.

panels.title: Successful checks · 24h
panels.description: Rolling fraction of successful recorded probe samples, not a current status or a wall-clock uptime guarantee. Missing scrapes are not counted as successful samples.

panels.title: GitLab readiness
panels.description: Each exported check retains its service, check and dependency labels. Results expire after 10 minutes and require a current successful node scrape.

targets.expr: service_check_success{service=~"gitlab|registry|gitlab-runner"} and on (host, service, check, dependency) (time() - service_check_last_run_timestamp_seconds < 600) and on (host) ((up{job="node"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="node"}) < 90)) == 1)

panels.title: GitLab processes
panels.description: Active state of GitLab and its declared dependencies. Inactive is red; an absent unit metric is unknown. Activity does not prove application readiness.

panels.title: Current failed application checks
panels.description: Only failed checks from a successfully scraped host with a check run in the last 10 minutes. No rows does not prove health: inspect check freshness and node scrape status.

targets.expr: (service_check_success{service=~"gitlab|registry|gitlab-runner"} and on (host, service, check, dependency) (time() - service_check_last_run_timestamp_seconds < 600) and on (host) ((up{job="node"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="node"}) < 90)) == 1)) == 0

panels.title: Alert rules: pending and firing
panels.description: Prometheus rule state only. Firing alerts can be inhibited, silenced or grouped by Alertmanager; this panel does not confirm that a notification was delivered. No rows means no matching active rule series.

targets.expr: max by (alertname, alertstate, host, service, scope, severity) (ALERTS{alertstate=~"pending|firing",service=~"gitlab|registry|gitlab-runner"})

panels.title: Check age
panels.description: Age since each dependency check last ran. Values at or above 10 minutes invalidate current check status.

panels.title: Backend metrics scrape
panels.description: Current scrape of media-server's node exporter. Host alerts are also available in the service overview.

panels.title: CPU busy
panels.description: Non-idle CPU time, averaged across cores. Historical series; gaps stay empty.

panels.title: Memory in use
panels.description: RAM used as a share of total, using MemAvailable to account for reclaimable cache.

panels.title: CPU waiting for storage
panels.description: Sustained I/O wait helps identify storage pressure while services remain reachable.

panels.title: GitLab filesystems used
panels.description: Root, ZFS pool and GitLab dataset usage. Mountpoint labels show which backing filesystem holds the service data.

panels.title: GitLab filesystem space available
panels.description: Bytes available on the backing filesystems for GitLab state and backups. Unknown when host metrics are unavailable.

panels.title: GitLab journal diagnostics
panels.description: Optional Loki view of journal messages containing error, warning, failure or fatal. Messages are diagnostic context, not a health verdict. Uses the configured Alloy host and unit labels.
